# Scope : province
E_kCAFG_custom_province_setup_clear_all = {
    E_kCAFG_custom_province_setup = yes
    E_kCAFG_clear_all_province_faiths = yes
    E_kCAFG_clear_all_province_cultures = yes
}

# Scope : province
E_kCAFG_custom_province_setup_clear_faiths = {
    E_kCAFG_custom_province_setup = yes
    E_kCAFG_clear_all_province_faiths = yes
}

# Scope : province
E_kCAFG_custom_province_setup_clear_cultures = {
    E_kCAFG_custom_province_setup = yes
    E_kCAFG_clear_all_province_cultures = yes
}

# Scope : province
E_kCAFG_custom_province_setup = {
    add_to_global_variable_list = {
        name = kCAFG_custom_setup_provinces_edited
        target = this
    }
    county = {
        add_to_global_variable_list = {
            name = kCAFG_custom_setup_counties_edited
            target = this
        }
    }
}

E_kCAFG_finish_custom_setup = {
    set_global_variable = kCAFG_ignore_tolerance_laws # For some reason the laws are wrongly evaluated when this part executes, so we ignore laws instead

    every_in_global_list = {
        variable = kCAFG_custom_setup_provinces_edited
        E_kCAFG_check_province_factors = yes # This will display errors if the province factor don't add up to 1
        E_kCAFG_update_province_target_culture_tension = yes
        set_variable = { name = kCAFG_culture_tension value = var:kCAFG_target_culture_tension }
        E_kCAFG_on_province_culture_tension_updated = yes
        E_kCAFG_update_province_target_faith_tension = yes
        set_variable = { name = kCAFG_faith_tension value = var:kCAFG_target_faith_tension }
        E_kCAFG_on_province_faith_tension_updated = yes
    }

    every_in_global_list = {
        variable = kCAFG_custom_setup_counties_edited
        E_kCAFG_update_county_cultures_list = yes
        E_kCAFG_update_county_culture = { REASON = flag:kCAFG_default_reason }
        E_kCAFG_update_county_faiths_list = yes
        E_kCAFG_update_county_faith = { REASON = flag:kCAFG_default_reason }
    }

    remove_global_variable = kCAFG_ignore_tolerance_laws
    clear_global_variable_list = kCAFG_custom_setup_provinces_edited
    clear_global_variable_list = kCAFG_custom_setup_counties_edited
}

# Scope : province
E_kCAFG_check_province_factors = {
    ## CULTURE ##
    set_global_variable = {
        name = kCAFG_province_total_factor
        value = {
            value = 0
            every_in_list = {
                variable = kCAFG_province_culture_structs
                add = var:factor
            }
        }
    }

    if = {
        limit = { global_var:kCAFG_province_total_factor != 1 }
        error_log = "Wrong culture factor in province [THIS.Province.GetNameNoTooltip] ([THIS.Province.GetID])! Got [GetGlobalVariable('kCAFG_province_total_factor').GetValue|0%] (Expected 100%)."
    }
    ## FAITHS ##
    set_global_variable = {
        name = kCAFG_province_total_factor
        value = {
            value = 0
            every_in_list = {
                variable = kCAFG_province_faith_structs
                add = var:factor
            }
        }
    }

    if = {
        limit = { global_var:kCAFG_province_total_factor != 1 }
        error_log = "Wrong faith factor in province [THIS.Province.GetNameNoTooltip] ([THIS.Province.GetID])! Got [GetGlobalVariable('kCAFG_province_total_factor').GetValue|0%] (Expected 100%)."
    }
    ##
    remove_global_variable = kCAFG_province_total_factor
}
